title: Where Tree Ensembles Decide: Structural Local Explanation with Decision Predicate Graphs
abstract: arXiv:2611.18382v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Tree ensembles are among the most accurate models for tabular data, yet the computation behind a single prediction is spread over hundreds of decision rules. Feature attributions and counterfactuals explain such predictions through the influence of features or a change of the input, leaving open which of the thresholds applied by the trees a prediction responds to, while structural explanations compress these rules and lose the trees behind them. To address this gap, we propose a local Decision Predicate Graph (local DPG), which gathers the rules executed for a sample into a verifiable record of the computation, with a class support that reproduces every explained prediction. From these rules we select the critical predicate, the executed predicate whose crossing is estimated to move the model most strongly toward a chosen class, which offers the user a concrete threshold and the trees that share it, without an external explainer. translated_title: 树集成在哪里做出决策：基于决策谓词图的结构化局部解释
translated_abstract: 树集成是表格数据上最准确的模型之一，但单次预测背后的计算分散在数百条决策规则之中。特征归因和反事实方法通过特征的影响或输入的变化来解释此类预测，却未能说明预测究竟响应的是树所应用的哪些阈值，而结构化解释虽然压缩了这些规则，却丢失了其背后的树结构。为弥补这一空白，我们提出了局部决策谓词图，它将针对某个样本执行的所有规则收集为一个可验证的计算记录，其类别支持能够复现每一个被解释的预测。从这些规则中，我们选出“关键谓词”，即根据估计，其阈值被越过时会使模型最强烈地趋向所选类别的已执行谓词，从而为用户提供一个具体的阈值以及共享该阈值的树，而无需任何外部解释器。
tldr: 该论文提出局部决策谓词图，将树集成对单个样本的预测计算记录为可验证的执行规则集合，并从中识别出关键谓词（即一个具体的阈值及共享它的树），使用户无需外部解释器即可定位模型决策的决定性因素。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the local Decision Predicate Graph (local DPG), which gathers the rules executed for a sample into a verifiable record of the computation and identifies the critical predicate—a concrete threshold shared by specific trees—allowing users to pinpoint the decisive factor of a tree ensemble's prediction without an external explainer.
